Software Engineering Knowledge Base (SWEBOK) v4.0a defines software engineering management as activities that involve planning, scheduling, budgeting, and controlling the software development process. These activities include managing resources, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring the project stays within scope and meets deadlines.

SWEBOK v4.0a does not establish universal consensus on software engineering management. While it provides a comprehensive framework, different organizations and industries may have their own specific practices and methodologies. The document is a guide and may not cover all aspects of management activities universally.
